messages.en:
I {01 00 00 05 00}really like peeking into{01 00 00 05 00}
{07 14 00}other people's houses. {01 00 00 05 00}And
snooping, too!
{07 00 00}So, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 1f 00},{01 00 00 0a 00} {07 0b 00}can I come
over sometime?! It'll be a
blast! {01 00 00 0a 00}{ff 00 00 04}(For me, anyway.)
{ff 00 00 00}{07 00 00}I think you can tell a lot 
about someone {01 00 00 05 00}by the way
they set up their house.
And I wanna know more
about you, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
messages.et:
Mulle {01 00 00 05 00}meeldib piiluda{01 00 00 05 00}
{07 14 00}teiste kodudesse. {01 00 00 05 00}Ja
ka nuuskida!
{07 00 00}Nii et, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 1f 00},{01 00 00 0a 00} {07 0b 00}kas võin
kunagi külla tulla?! Tuleb
lõbus! {01 00 00 0a 00}{ff 00 00 04}(Vähemalt mulle.)
{ff 00 00 00}{07 00 00}Inimese kohta saab palju
teada {01 00 00 05 00}sellest, kuidas
ta oma kodu sisustab.
Ja ma tahan sinu kohta
rohkem teada, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.

messages.en:
